module: IM TCG Opal SSC SSD Series
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Rules Section of the Security Policy. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: IM TCG Opal SSC SSD Series are high-performance, self-encrypting solid state (Flash) drives that support either the SATA or NVMe interface. User data is protected by an AES-256XTS on-the-fly hardware encryption algorithm that does not compromise data transfer rates. This SS series implements several FIPS approved cryptographic algorithms. The FIPS approved services are provided via the TCG Opal protocol.
